data.name: Nayana
data.gender_notes: Nayana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Nayana means 'eye' or 'vision'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, symbolizing the inner and outer worlds, as the eyes are the windows to the soul and the gateway to the divine. The name Nayana carries the meaning “Eye, Vision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nayana usually hope their child will grow to embody eye, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the power of perception and insight, guiding one towards wisdom and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Nayana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eye, Vision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nayana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, the eyes are considered the windows to the soul and a profound symbol of spiritual enlightenment. The name 'Nayana' is a reminder of this belief, emphasizing the concept of introspection and self-awareness through the reverence of the physical eye. The significance of eye health is further emphasized by various Hindu practices and festivals dedicated to the deities associated with the eyes, such as Saraswati for knowledge and the sun god, Surya, for vision.
data.spiritual_significance: Celestial beings like the gods and goddesses in Hinduism possess the power of omniscience or the ability to see beyond the physical realm. The name 'Nayana' can serve as a reminder for individuals to strive for inner vision through spiritual practices like meditation, self-reflection, and service to others. The name embodies the Hindu belief that true wisdom comes not from material possessions or physical abilities, but from the understanding of the self and the inner world, enabling an individual to achieve spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nayana symbolizes insightful vision and inner wisdom. It is believed that those named Nayana possess the ability to see beyond the physical realm and perceive the deeper truths of life.
